verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs say it blocks flexible time for Tasks before their due dates, works around everything else on the calendar, and can split longer projects into chunks. They also say it automatically schedules and reschedules events when conflicts arise, guided by P1–P4 priorities, and moves overbooked smart events to the next best time. A hands-on Tasks user confirms their reserved work time adjusts as new meetings come in. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of what triggers a re-plan and its edge cases, such as one user's report that Habits only move after a Yes/Maybe RSVP.
